minutes.headline: Commission approved a Lake Shirley dock over a neighbor's objection, with a perpendicular-to-shore condition.
minutes.summary: The vice chair presided in the chair's absence. The commission heard hearings on a house addition at 57 Round Road, a removable dock at 607 Reservoir Road, and an amended order at 386 Sunset Lane. Several other hearings were continued. It also extended one order of conditions, issued two certificates of compliance, and directed a violation notice to 12 Fire Road.

public_comment.topic: Representatives for 255 Sunny Hill Road said the third-party wetland flagging review had not been sent to consultants and asked the commission to get it moving.
Resident asked how to close out an order of conditions where replacement trees were proposed but the original trees were not removed.
Resident asked whether the certificate of compliance for 200 Bird Street would be taken up tonight.
Owner of 611 and 609 Reservoir Road objected to the neighbor's proposed dock length and angle across his frontage, with maps and photos.

budget_items.what_was_said: The vice chair suggested the commission may pay for removal given court reluctance, but wait until a logging operation brings in money.
A member suggested the fire department might burn the shed as a training exercise instead of paying for removal.
No fees attach to a non-compliance letter, but daily fines may follow if the owner does not appear.

what_happened.line: The Conservation Commission voted to issue a negative determination for a removable dock at 607 Reservoir Road, on condition that it sit perpendicular to the shoreline.
It voted 4-1 to ask the administrator to issue an enforcement order to the owner of 609 Reservoir Road regarding his dock.
It approved a notice of intent for a house addition at 57 Round Road, on condition that impervious surface calculations be added to the plan.
It voted to direct a violation notice to 12 Fire Road, with possible daily fines if the owner does not appear on May 1.
It continued hearings for 390 Howard Street, 255 Sunny Hill Road and 386 Sunset Lane to May 1, and 171 Arbor Street to May 15.

why_it_matters: Dock approvals and enforcement orders on Lake Shirley and Reservoir Road shape what shoreline owners may build, and a neighbor's objection did not stop the approval.
Residents with projects near wetlands face conditions, continued hearings and possible daily fines, so timing and compliance with an order of conditions matter.
watch_next: May 1 meeting: continued hearings for 390 Howard Street, 255 Sunny Hill Road and 386 Sunset Lane, and the 12 Fire Road owner's appearance on the violation notice.
May 15 meeting: continued hearing for 171 Arbor Street.
